name: Research Network
title:
A familiar network.
A fresh invitation.
intro: A closer look at the Research Network website, then and next. Four pages, the same community, and a new way to bring people together.

pages.label: Home
pages.heading: A welcome that feels like an invitation.
pages.summary: Bring the people and gatherings to the front. The proposed homepage gives the Network's community a more immediate presence.
pages.beforeNote: An introduction to the Network leads the page, beneath a narrow strip of photographs.
pages.afterNote: Generous photographs and a warmer opening introduce the community, with clear links to membership and what’s on.

pages.label: Events
pages.heading: Make the next gathering easy to find.
pages.summary: Give events a clear place in the life of the Network, with an invitation-led layout and room for the details members need.
pages.beforeNote: The public Events page shows the site header and footer but no event details in this capture.
pages.afterNote: An invitation for the day’s NED Talk leads the page, with a date, calendar action and a route to event details.

pages.label: Gallery
pages.heading: Give the photographs room to tell the story.
pages.summary: The photographs are part of the Network's shared history. A more generous gallery makes them easier to discover and enjoy.
pages.beforeNote: The existing gallery is shown at the same viewport size, preserving the public page as captured.
pages.afterNote: Larger photographs and clear groupings give each gathering its own place in the proposed gallery.

pages.label: Membership
pages.heading: A clearer first step into the Network.
pages.summary: Explain what membership feels like and make the next step visible. The new application journey is part of the preview, not a live membership service.
pages.beforeNote: The existing membership page is shown as a first-time visitor would encounter it.
pages.afterNote: The proposal pairs a welcoming introduction with a visible invitation to apply, leading into the preview application flow.
